chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: Holder's gambling and the band voting Andy Kirk in as leader
summary: Holder gambles away the band's pay; the owner Faulkenberg tells the men to take over the business, and they vote Andy Kirk to run it.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Another thing, he--maybe it is good and maybe it is bad, but T would play--I got to be pretty close to him, because Andy Kirk went on to the big time-that was T. Holder that made that band.

I was right there, and so when he wasn't talking about the gambling what T would do at that time, he had about a twelve piece band which was big money, they were only getting about seven hundred dollars a week, that's less than a hundred dollars apiece, but when they paid T off--Faulkenberg would pay him off--he was married to a woman in Dallas, Texas, he would walk out the back door, get in his car and head for Dalllas and if he won, when he came back they got their money and might get a tip;
What kind of gambling did he do?
Poker, craps, anything; he was just a gambler, and would gamble on all the guys' money.

Finally, Faulkenberg said to me-- another man that encouraged me to get a big band--right at that same time, he said he had a talk with the band. He said you all are getting to be too much of a headache; he said, can anybody run the band? He said I don't have anything against T, but it's too much headache. He said I'm surprised you all are not tired of it. I pay him, he goes to Dallas, half the time he's losing money, you're begging me for money, you owe your hotel bill, you got nothing to eat and everything. He said somebody needs to get somebody for a manager, or somebody else to handle the money.
And so, when T came back that
time, they voted him out. They weren't going to put him out of the band, because they all liked him, but they wanted him to let somebody else handle the money.
Yes, the business of it and they wanted--he never did lie about the money, but you just weren't going to get what you were supposed to get if he got in that game and lost.
So they voted Kirk to do that and T wouldn't go for it.
Andy was playing in the band?
Yes, saxophone and bass. Andy was a bass player too.
